rows: 「規」は規制銘柄。「日」は日々公表銘柄、「監」は売買監理銘柄、「株」は日証金における貸株申込制限銘柄。「喚」は日証金における貸株注意喚起銘柄。「○」は不明確情報等により注意喚起の対象となった銘柄、特別注意銘柄等。
｢制」は制度信用銘柄、「貸」は貸借銘柄、「他」はその他銘柄。
全ての銘柄を１株単位で表示。なお、「投信」の残高は、１口を１株として表示。
前日比欄の「▲」は減少、無印は増加。
ETF及びETNについては「*」と表示（上場比は算出しない）。
"規": indicates restricted issue, "日": issue subject to daily publication, "監": issue under trade monitoring,"株": JSF has placed restrictions on the application for the use of stocks for loan trading,
"喚": JSF has placed a notice for precaution for the use of stocks for loan trading, "○": issue subject to alert on unclear information, Securities on Special Alert, etc.
A indicates 1 share, J: 10 shares, K: 50 shares, B: 100 shares, M: 200 shares, C: 500 shares, T: 1,000 shares, F: 3,000 shares per unit.
"制" indicates standardized margin trading issue, "貸" indicates loan trading issue, "他" indicates other issues.
Displayed in units of 1 share for all issues. 1 unit for "Investment Trusts" is indicated as 1 share.
▲ indicates fall, no symbol indicates rise.
For ETFs and ETNs, * is indicated.(Ratio to listed shares is not calculated.)
